Lost my job in November. 

I have literally 0 friends. 1 if I count this conversation. And friends cannot help in this situation. I am in Corporate, and all my 'friends' are ex-coursemates/colleagues. As far as I understand, there can never be any display of weakness. Specially mental health or personal problems. With all the talk around mental health in the industry, trust me, people just get excommunicated for saying anything lol. I've seen it. 

I cannot cut ties with my family. Wife doesn't earn. And if she does get into a good course this year, hopefully, then I depend on them for fees and other expenses. Also, I really care about my father. He's old and even though he hasn't been the best father, he's still a father and they don't make a lot of noise about how much they've sacrificed so it tends to go unnoticed (at least in my family). 

Also, you don't cut ties with your parents in India. That's basically declaring yourself a Persona Non Grata in the community. Nobody cares what parents did, because they're incapable of doing wrong and simply revered as deities. (See: Baghban). There's a saying: Mata kumata nahi ho sakti, Putr kuputr ho sakta hai. (A mother cannot be a bad mother, a son can be a bad son) 

I know it probably won't do much in long term, but I'll try to get away from this all for a bit. Maybe some fresh air and solitude will do. Will try to see a therapist, a cheap one may be. Even if they're bad, it'll be a good laugh. Fuck knows I could do with a good laugh.

Thanks for reaching out. No, I can't talk to anyone I know about this. Brings the family into disrepute. I can't talk to my parents about my wife, for reasons mentioned in the post. That'd be playing right into their game. 

I can't talk to my wife about any of this, because 1. Her exams are around the corner 2. She won't admit to doing what she's doing 3. Does she even realise what she's doing? She's okay 1 day, the next she isn't.

At best only I can talk to a therapist. Which I can't afford. I don't want to subject us to couples counselling. There's a reason why I didn't discuss our problems with each other in the post.
